title: KeyLens
description: A lightweight quality-of-life mod that adds a handy search bar to the controls screen. No more endless scrolling—just type and find your keybinds instantly!
body:
KeyLens is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that adds in-place keybind search to the Controls screen.

Instead of opening a separate menu, KeyLens lets you filter the built-in keybind list directly inside the vanilla Controls screen. It supports fuzzy matching for short inputs and field-specific searches with prefixes like `category:`, `name:`, and `key:`.

Features:
- Search directly inside the existing Controls screen
- Filter by category, keybind name, or bound key
- Fuzzy matching for short or partial inputs
- Prefix-based searches like `category:movement`, `name:jump`, and `key:space`
- Client-side only
- Keeps the vanilla Controls screen flow intact
![search for key](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/066c59c86dec1091f441569b3356ce365a6c9df7_0.webp)

KeyLens is the first step in a broader keybind-focused utility mod. More keybind-related features will be added over time.
